description.narrative: Myanmar Digital Rights Forum 2018 is a two day conference planned for 18-19 January 2018. The purpose is to take stock of the progress (or regressions) achieved in 2017 with regard to strengthened digital rights in Myanmar and support the joint identification of priorities and opportunities for engagement 2018.

Myanmar Forum för Digitala Rättigheter 2018 är en två-dagars konferens som planeras till den 18-19 januari 2018. Syftet är att utvärdera framgångar (eller bakslag) 2017 i arbetet för stärkta digitala rättigheter i Myanmar samt understödja gemensam identifiering av prioriteringar och möjligheter för engagemang 2018.

sector.narrative: Media and free flow of information

description.narrative: The objectives for the Myanmar Digital Rights Forum 2018 was for the digital rights movement to 1) collaborately take stock of progress (or regresssions) achieved in 2017, and 2) support the joint identification of priorities and opportunities for engagement for 2018. 138 key stakeholders: civil society, activists, lawyers, media and government participated in the MDRF (47 % women). The situation regarding digital rights werre discussed and priorities for 2018 within the areas of freedom of expression, right to privacy, equality of access were concluded.
